versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive documentation covering usage principles, execution flow, prerequisites, environment preparation, and directory structure.
- Clarified scope as read-only IAM queries using Python SDK scripts; all write operations are excluded.
- Strictly prohibits the use of hcloud, openstack, curl, or direct API calls; all queries must use packaged scripts executed via skill action.
- Step-by-step skill execution instructions included—environment check, script invocation, and result handling.
- Supports querying Huawei Cloud IAM users, groups, policies, agencies, AK/SK, MFA devices, password/ACL policies, security compliance, and quotas.
